about:
EVCO Plastics runs a 110,000-square-foot injection molding plant in Calhoun, Georgia, known as the CAL1 facility. The site houses 17 molding machines with clamp forces up to 3,300 tons. The company does not disclose a founding date or ownership structure for this location in its public materials.

The Calhoun plant specializes in custom plastic injection molding and offers a range of processes including scientific injection molding, gas-assist molding, overmolding, insert molding, in-mold decorating and labeling, multi-shot molding, and liquid silicone rubber molding. It also provides tool and mold building, secondary operations such as UV coating, and contract manufacturing services. The facility supports large-part molding and metal-to-plastic conversion projects.

EVCO Calhoun serves the medical and healthcare, plastic packaging, consumer products, and industrial products sectors. The company cites a medical device manufacturer as a reference customer and emphasizes early supplier involvement for design-for-manufacturability support.

The company positions itself as an early-involvement partner, offering engineering services such as design for manufacturability, material selection, metrology, and robotics and automation integration to help customers reduce risk and accelerate time to market.
